title: 1981-04-16_Pat_161.txt
concise_summary: PKD develops a Christology grounded in information theory and Gnostic metaphysics, arguing that Christ is cosmic hyper-information that penetrates and modulates the universe-as-information-system. Drawing on Pauline theology, Eliade's phenomenology, Manichaean soteriology, and the Sepher Yetzirah's 22 Hebrew letters, PKD claims that Christ's work as savior involves interrupting both physical law (causation) and moral law (Torah), replacing retributive justice with mercy—constituting the emergence of a 23rd corrective letter that transforms reality from mechanical necessity into flexible judgment.
key_claims: God, Christ, and the Logos exist as unitary information-entities where idea, word, writing, and object cannot be separated—unlike human language which merely signifies external things.
Christ is present throughout reality via macrocosm-microcosm correspondence: universally in all reality and specifically in Scripture, which the Old Testament secretly contains in encoded form.
The universe is stipulated as information, and Christ as Logos penetrates it as hyper-information, modulating reality as a cosmic perturbation—not the carrier itself but what uses the carrier.

Christ's salvific action (sōtēr) requires simultaneously overruling both physical law (efficient causality) and Mosaic law (lex talionis) to enable intelligent choice within what appears as mechanical necessity.

The 23rd Hebrew letter (currently missing from creation's original 22) represents Christ's corrective addition, which transforms the retributive torah into a system of mercy and freedom—the messianic age already breaking through.

The Plasmate (Christ's blood) functions as rogue information infiltrating the cosmos, sabotaging the retributive machinery by blocking information, thus enacting a cosmic Eucharist in the vegetable kingdom and all innocent creation.

tensions: PKD did not realize during the 3-74 experience or while writing VALIS that perceiving the universe as information was a necessary prerequisite for discriminating Christ's presence—a meta-abstraction that came later.

If Christ modulates reality as hyper-information, how is He not identical to the carrier He modulates? PKD claims 'He is not it but returns it,' creating a functional distinction that remains mysteriously unclear.

The retributive machinery (heimarmene) is itself said to be God's will and Torah's role, yet Christ (or a rogue God?) sabotages it with mercy—raising the question of whether God's own laws are flawed or whether this represents a higher third epoch of divine intention.
PKD invokes monotheism yet requires viewing a dialectic/bifurcation within God (justice vs. mercy), suggesting an internal conflict requiring external correction through Christ's advent.
VALIS appears to be simultaneously Christ's cosmic body and a separate entity infiltrating reality; their relationship and distinctness remain unresolved.

The concept that 'all animals and men feed on Christ unknowingly' in the Eucharist writ large seems to differ from human consciousness and consent, creating a tension between cosmic sacrament and moral agency.

uncertainty_flags: PKD's reference to Hainuwele (a Dema-deity from Indonesian myth) and the connection to Christ as patibilis (suffering deity) is asserted but not elaborated; the parallel needs scholarly verification.
The claim that Eliade points to primitive knowledge of Teilhard's Point Omega is not directly cited; the connection is PKD's inference.

PKD notes 'although to my knowledge Eliade does not note the connection' between murdered deities returning, teaching, and sinking into camouflage—suggesting PKD is making an original synthesis not explicitly in Eliade.
The notation '63-2013 D-152' and similar appears to be an archival or reference code; its meaning is unclear without more context.
The reference to '11-1-81' as a date when PKD realized Torah and physical law function in fusion is dated but not explained contextually.
The text breaks off mid-sentence at 'While new combinations [of letters] would be generated... of Beethoven).' with 'new' hanging, suggesting truncation or incomplete transcription.
